page.layout: One page of text, one column, with no marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number 386 at the head left.

main_text.p: quam tranquillum & tutum reddant ani-mum circa ea quæ in Religionibus quibus-vis disputantur; quam universaliter con-troversiis finem imponant; hæresibus o-mnibus interitum procurent; & verò ex-citent, percutiant, penetrent nec quie-scere finant cor nostrum donec dedatur Deo, ejusque divinæ uni voluntati tradatur ab omnibus rebus evanidis disjunctum, soli necessario adhærens, partibus nullis viti-ose addictum, pacificum, humile, conten-tum; atque, ut verbo dicam, deprehendent probi lectores sibi per ea satisfieri de o-mnibus quæ quidem circa theoriam & prae-xim, externam & internam vitæ institutio-nem erga Deum, erga se, erga alios, probos juxta atque improbos, moveri & desiderari posse: idque fieri non obscuris quibus-dam modis; sed cum incredibili quadam ac-commodatione & facilitate nulli comparan-da, quam etiam vel infantuli bonæ volun-tatis capiant in rebus alioqui arduis & sub-limibus; cumque tanta evidentia atque cla-ritate indubia, nec non ea scopi, solum amo-rem Dei spirantis, solam peccati destructi-onem intendentis puritate; ut non capiam sane qui fieri queat, aliquos coram Deo & in sinu non esse improbos, & simul tamen o-pera adeo divina damnare aut contemnere posse, si modo ea legerint, aut eorum saltem præcipua, veluti Lucem Mundi, v.g. aut Lu-cem in tenebris, aut Anti-Christum detectum, aut tractatum de Solida Virtute, aut Renova-tionem Spiritus Evangelici, aut Lapidem Ly-dium,

page.notes: The short quotation marks at the start of each line are printed quotes and are not transcribed. The last line is slightly damaged at the foot, and the words "Renovationem Spiritus Evangelici" are partly smudged in the scan; the readings are the most likely ones. Dots and specks in the margins are scan artefacts.
